title: PixelKin - Down the Wick-Run (SNES register)
_note: The Wick-Run (09-the-wild-ways §2A): the old wax-carters' chute down the dark mountain's west flank, raced at night by the Runners on runner-wheels. Driving and reckless, all forward motion: 168 BPM, 4/4, E minor (Dorian lift through G/D in A'), galloping tri_bass eighths, rock drum kit, pulse25 hook in pushed eighths. SNES register per score bible §3.3: strings pad carries the real chords, pluck harp eighth-arps (the spokes), sparse bell at phrase ends = the lamps whipping past. Form A A' B A'': B is the JUMP - long airborne notes, half-time drums, pad swells - then the hook slams back in. Vesper motif: the climbing-route WIDENED leap (B4->E5->F#5 overshoot in bar 1's E5/B4/G5 figure; the settle is skipped - nobody settles on the Run). Last bar runs up B4-D#5-F#5-B5 into the E downbeat. 32 bars = ~45.7 s. Remaster is NEVER motif-conditioned (it would pin the tempo to the lullaby's ~90 BPM). Original (VISION.md).
